title: Mezz Mezzrow's feeling for the blues
summary: Freeman and Dance agree Mezzrow's love and feeling for the blues were authentic despite his limited facility.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the blues is, and why every jazz player needs it

blocks.x: Now, Mezz Mezzrow had a great profound feeling and he loved the music, if I am not being too crude, I don't believe that Mezzrow had the, shall we say, the facility to go on and do something for himself, but I think he is to be given a lot of credit for what -- for the love he --
Well, Bud, Mezz, I can't help but feel that Mezz, although he had such small facility, what facility he had was authentic, and --
He had a marvelous feeling for the blues.
And his feeling and his sound were real and --
So he has to be given credit for that, don't you think.
